import importlib.util, time
from pyscipopt import quicksum
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mysolve','/app/submissions/solve.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
inst=mod.load_instance(); sp=mod.build_station_patterns(inst); routes=mod.build_route_patterns(inst, sp); mod.add_route_metrics(inst, routes); cands=mod.build_candidates(inst, routes)
res=mod.solve_restoration_assignment(inst, cands, mod.RESTORATION_BUNDLES, 20)
sel=res['selected_candidates']
sel_ids={c['candidate_id'] for c in sel}
# positions from incumbent
byv={}
for c in sel:
    byv.setdefault(c['vehicle_id'], []).append(c)
inc_keys=[]
for v,items in byv.items():
    items.sort(key=lambda c:(c['load_start_min'], c['candidate_id']))
    for pos,c in enumerate(items, start=1):
        idx=next(i for i,cc in enumerate(cands) if cc['candidate_id']==c['candidate_id'])
        inc_keys.append((idx,pos))
print('incumbent', res['objective'], len(inc_keys), flush=True)
model,x=mod.build_master_model(inst, cands, 30, [])
# add mip start
sol=model.createSol()
inc_set=set(inc_keys)
for key,var in x.items():
    model.setSolVal(sol, var, 1.0 if key in inc_set else 0.0)
accepted=model.addSol(sol, False)
print('mip start accepted', accepted, flush=True)
# local branching radius 4
model.addCons(quicksum(1 - x[key] for key in inc_set) + quicksum(x[key] for key in x if key not in inc_set) <= 4, name='local_branch')
# objective improvement cutoff tiny
model.addCons(quicksum(cands[idx]['objective_cost'] * x[(idx,pos)] for idx in range(len(cands)) for pos in (1,2)) <= res['objective'] - 1e-5)
model.optimize()
print('status', model.getStatus(), 'nsol', model.getNSols(), 'obj', model.getObjVal() if model.getNSols()>0 else None, 'bound', model.getDualbound(), 'gap', model.getGap(), flush=True)
if model.getNSols()>0:
    selected=mod.extract_selected_master_solution(model,x,cands)
    sc=[c for _,c in selected]
    bay=mod.solve_bay_assignment(inst, sc, 20)
    print('bay', bay is not None, None if bay is None else bay['objective'])
    if bay:
        soln=mod.compose_solution(sc,bay)
        val=mod.validate_solution(inst, soln)
        print('val', val['feasible'], val['total_objective'])
        print([(c['vehicle_id'], c['slot_id'], c['station_ids']) for c in sc])
PY"
